polls.note: Vox Brasil national poll released on 02/Oct, registration BR-00148/2026, 2,100 voters interviewed face to face between 29/Sep and 01/Oct, margin of 2.15pp with 95% confidence, conducted with the institute's own funds (BNews SP, OCP News and GP1). ⭐ IN THE [FIRST ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) FLÁVIO BOLSONARO HAS 41.2% AND LULA 40.4%, within the margin, after Lula led by 41.1% to 37.8% in the pollster's round released on 29/Sep, with Ronaldo Caiado at 3.3%, Renan Santos at 2.2%, Romeu Zema at 1.3% and Augusto Cury at 1.2%; blank, null and none add up to 3.2% and 7% did not know. ⚖️ IN THE [SECOND ROUND](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) FLÁVIO BOLSONARO HAS 48.2% AND LULA 45.2%, within the margin, after 45.2% to 44.7% for him on 29/Sep. Lula wins the other two pairings tested: 46.3% to 42.1% against Ronaldo Caiado and 46.8% to 33.1% against Augusto Cury.

National Datafolha poll released on 01/Oct at 19h, registration BR-08039/2026, 2,506 interviews from 28/Sep to 01/Oct, margin of 2pp (CartaCapital, Metrópoles and VEJA). It is the pollster's second-to-last round before the first round; the last one is registered for 03/Oct. ⭐ IN THE [FIRST ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) LULA HAS 42% AND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO 38%, both 2 points above the 24/Sep round, which measured 40% to 36%, with Augusto Cury at 4%, Ronaldo Caiado and Renan Santos at 3% each and Romeu Zema at 1%. In valid votes, Lula has 45% and Flávio Bolsonaro 40%, according to Folha de S.Paulo. ⚖️ IN THE [SECOND ROUND](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) LULA HAS 48% AND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO 45%, after 47% to 45% on 24/Sep, within the margin. Lula wins the other four pairings tested: 48% to 42% against Ronaldo Caiado, 47% to 42% against Augusto Cury, 49% to 40% against Romeu Zema and 48% to 39% against Renan Santos. Government approval, according to O Globo: 48% against 49% disapproval.

National Real Time Big Data poll released on 01/Oct, registration BR-09503/2026, 2,000 telephone interviews with human interviewers from 26 to 30/Sep, margin of 2pp at 95% confidence, commissioned by the institute itself (Exame, UOL and Brasil de Fato). 🏷️ This pollster's sampling plan says "national" in its state polls too, so the label was checked against the release: the poll includes breakdowns for the Northeast, the South and the Center-West, which only exist in a national sample. ⭐ IN THE [FIRST ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) LULA HAS 43% AND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO 39%, against 41% to 37% in the pollster's 24/Sep round, with Renan Santos at 4%, Augusto Cury and Ronaldo Caiado at 3% each and Romeu Zema at 1%. ⚖️ IN THE [SECOND ROUND](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) FLÁVIO BOLSONARO HAS 46% AND LULA 45%, within the margin, after 45% to 44% for him on 24/Sep. Against Ronaldo Caiado Lula has 45% to 43%, against Augusto Cury 45% to 44% and against Romeu Zema 45% to 40%. 🚫 Rejection: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro at 49% each, Renan Santos at 43%. Government approval: 46% against 52%.

Futura Inteligência with 100% Cidades, national poll released on 30/Sep, registration BR-01122/2026, 2,000 computer-assisted telephone interviews, margin of 2.2pp at 95% confidence (Rádio Itatiaia and Exame). 🏷️ Rádio Itatiaia and Exame give fieldwork from 25 to 29/Sep and the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) registration declares 24 to 29/Sep; the panel keeps the registration's dates and declares the difference. ⭐ IN THE [FIRST ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) FLÁVIO BOLSONARO HAS 42.2% AND LULA 39.4%, against 40.4% to 38.4% in the 24/Sep round, with Ronaldo Caiado at 4%, Augusto Cury at 3.8%, Renan Santos at 3.2% and Romeu Zema at 1.6%. ⚖️ IN THE [SECOND ROUND](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) FLÁVIO BOLSONARO HAS 49% AND LULA 43.5%, the only distance outside the margin among the national polls of 30/Sep and 01/Oct. It is also the only pollster among them in which Lula loses to Ronaldo Caiado, by 42.4% to 45.6%, and to Augusto Cury, by 42% to 45.1%; against Romeu Zema he has 45.1% to 42.2% and against Renan Santos 44.6% to 40.7%. 🚫 Rejection: 48.9% for Lula and 45.6% for Flávio Bolsonaro. Government approval: 44.1% against 52.8%.

Ideia for Canal Meio, national poll released on 30/Sep, registration BR-08706/2026, 2,000 interviews from 25 to 28/Sep, margin of 2.2pp at 95% confidence (Gazeta do Povo and Folha de S.Paulo). ⭐ IN THE [FIRST ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) LULA HAS 39.4% AND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO 38.4%, within the margin, with Augusto Cury at 6.7%, Renan Santos at 4.5%, Ronaldo Caiado at 4.4% and Romeu Zema at 3.5%. In the spontaneous question, Lula has 31.5%, Flávio Bolsonaro 30.5% and 17.5% do not know. ⚖️ IN THE [SECOND ROUND](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) LULA HAS 48.5% AND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO 48%, after a tie at 46% in the 09/Sep round. Approval, according to CNN Brasil: 49% against 49%.

Indexa for Broadcast, from Agência Estado, national poll released on 30/Sep, registration BR-00698/2026, 2,000 interviews from 27 to 29/Sep, margin of 2.2pp at 95% confidence (Gazeta do Povo and CNN Brasil). ⭐ IN THE [FIRST ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) LULA HAS 39% AND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO 34%, against 38% to 34% in the 15/Sep round, with Ronaldo Caiado and Augusto Cury at 4% each, Renan Santos at 3% and Romeu Zema at 1%. ⚖️ IN THE [SECOND ROUND](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) LULA HAS 43% AND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO 42%, the same score as on 15/Sep, within the margin. Government approval: 46% against 51% disapproval.

AtlasIntel national poll in partnership with Bloomberg released on 29/Sep, [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) registration BR-04391/2026, 5,005 interviews by random digital recruitment between 23 and 28/Sep, margin of 1.0pp at 95% confidence (Sul 21, Panorama da Bahia, JOTA and Diário de Goiás). ⭐ IN THE [FIRST ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) LULA HAS 45.3% AND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO 42.2%, with Renan Santos at 5.2%, Augusto Cury at 2.0%, Ronaldo Caiado at 1.8% and Romeu Zema at 0.9%. Against the pollster's 23/Sep round, which measured 45.8% to 43.4%, both slip, and the distance widens from 2.4 to 3.1 points. 🥉 Renan Santos is third, with more than Cury, Caiado and Zema combined. ⚖️ IN THE [SECOND ROUND](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) FLÁVIO BOLSONARO HAS 47.7% AND LULA 47.6%, after Lula led by 47.7% to 47.4% on 23/Sep; both readings are within the margin. Against Ronaldo Caiado, Lula has 45.9% to 43.4%, and against Renan Santos the opponent has 28.9%. Lula approval: 45.2% against 53.6% disapproval.

Palver national poll released on 29/Sep, registration BR-02990/2026, 5,000 interviews by online questionnaire, margin of 2.4pp at 95% confidence, funded by the institute itself (Correio Braziliense, Estado de Minas and JOTA). 🏷️ Correio Braziliense gives fieldwork from 24 to 27/Sep and the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) registration declares 24 to 28/Sep; the panel keeps the registration's dates and declares the difference. ⭐ IN THE [FIRST ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) LULA AND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO TIE AT 44%, with Renan Santos at 8% and Augusto Cury, Ronaldo Caiado and Romeu Zema at 1% each. In the 24/Sep round the tie was at 43%. ⚖️ IN THE [SECOND ROUND](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) FLÁVIO BOLSONARO HAS 47% AND LULA 45%, after 48% to 45% on 24/Sep, within the margin. 🚫 Rejection: 51% would not vote for Lula under any circumstances and 48% for Flávio Bolsonaro; Romeu Zema has 34%, Renan Santos 33%, Ronaldo Caiado 30% and Augusto Cury 28%.

Gerp national poll released on 29/Sep, registration BR-03929/2026, which the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) listed for release on 27/Sep, 2,400 interviews by telephone, margin of 2.0pp with a 95.55% confidence interval, conducted with the institute's own funds (CNN Brasil, Exame and GP1). 🏷️ CNN Brasil and Exame give fieldwork from 24 to 28/Sep and the TSE registration declares 23 to 26/Sep; the panel keeps the registration's dates and declares the difference. ⭐ IN THE [FIRST ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) FLÁVIO BOLSONARO HAS 42% AND LULA 40%, with Augusto Cury at 5%, Ronaldo Caiado and Renan Santos at 3% each and Romeu Zema and Samara Martins at 1% each. Against the pollster's previous round, Lula rises from 37% to 40% and Flávio Bolsonaro from 40% to 42%. ⚖️ IN THE [SECOND ROUND](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) FLÁVIO BOLSONARO HAS 50% AND LULA 43%, the widest distance among the national polls of 28 and 29/Sep, and the only one outside the poll's own margin. 🚫 Rejection, with multiple answers: 50% for Lula and 42% for Flávio Bolsonaro. Government approval: 44% against 51%.

Vox Brasil national poll released on 29/Sep, registration BR-00895/2026, 2,100 voters in in-person household interviews between 26 and 28/Sep, margin of 2.15pp at 95% confidence, commissioned by the institute itself (Exame, Metrópoles, CNN Brasil and Portal N10). ⭐ IN THE [FIRST ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) LULA HAS 41.1% AND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO 37.8%, with Ronaldo Caiado at 3.8%, Renan Santos at 2.7%, Augusto Cury at 2.2% and Romeu Zema at 1.8%. ⚖️ IN THE [SECOND ROUND](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) FLÁVIO BOLSONARO HAS 45.2% AND LULA 44.7%, within the margin, with 6.8% blank, null or none and 3.3% no answer. Lula wins the other three pairings tested: 45.3% to 41.1% against Ronaldo Caiado, 44.8% to 35.1% against Augusto Cury and 46.1% to 30.3% against Romeu Zema.

National [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) poll released on 28/Sep, [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) registration BR-06520/2026, 2,004 voters interviewed in person from Thursday to Sunday, 24 to 27/Sep, margin of 2.0pp at 95% confidence, commissioned by Grupo Globo (O Globo, G1, CartaCapital and CNN Brasil). Part of the fieldwork was done after the announcement of the ban on betting sites, on the night of 25/Sep, as the coverage itself notes. ⭐ IN THE [FIRST ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) LULA HAS 39% AND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO 34%, with Ronaldo Caiado and Augusto Cury at 4% each, Renan Santos at 3% and Romeu Zema at 1%. Against the 21/Sep wave, Lula shifts from 37% to 39% and Flávio Bolsonaro from 33% to 34%. ⚖️ IN THE [SECOND ROUND](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) THE TWO ARE TIED AT 42%, with 13% blank or null and 3% undecided, after Flávio Bolsonaro was 1 point ahead on 21/Sep; the shift is within the margin. 🔄 THE POLLSTER MEASURED VOTE TRANSFER: of Romeu Zema's first-round voters, 81% would go to Flávio Bolsonaro in the second and 9% to Lula; of Renan Santos's, 48% and 23%; of Ronaldo Caiado's, 42% and 30%; of Augusto Cury's, 34% and 27%, with 38% blank, null or abstention (O Globo). In the spontaneous question Lula has 31% and Flávio Bolsonaro 27%, and 76% say their vote is final. Government approval: 46% against 49%, after 44% against 50% on 21/Sep.

National BTG/Nexus poll released on 28/Sep, 16th wave of the pollster's series, registration BR-07557/2026, 2,000 voters by telephone between 25 and 27/Sep, margin of 2.0pp at 95% confidence, commissioned by the bank BTG Pactual (CNN Brasil, Correio Braziliense, Folha de S.Paulo and Estadão). ⭐ IN THE [FIRST ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) LULA HAS 42% AND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO 37%, with Augusto Cury and Ronaldo Caiado at 5% each, Renan Santos at 4%, Romeu Zema and Samara Martins at 1% each, 3% blank, null or none and 2% no answer. Against the 21/Sep wave, Lula shifts from 40% to 42% and Flávio Bolsonaro stays at 37%. ⚖️ THE POLLSTER TESTED FIVE SECOND-ROUND PAIRINGS AND LULA LEADS ALL FIVE: 46% to 44% against Flávio Bolsonaro, 46% to 42% against Ronaldo Caiado, 46% to 41% against Augusto Cury, 48% to 39% against Romeu Zema and 48% to 37% against Renan Santos. Against Flávio Bolsonaro the distance is within the margin. 🚫 Rejection: 51% would not vote for Flávio Bolsonaro under any circumstances and 48% for Lula, against 50% and 49% on 21/Sep; 7% reject both (Correio Braziliense). Government approval: 46% against 49%.

Palver national poll released on 24/Sep, [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) registration BR-09587/2026, 5,000 voters by online questionnaire between 20 and 23/Sep, survey funded by the institute itself, 95% confidence (CNN Brasil, UOL, Gazeta do Povo, CartaCapital and JOTA). ⭐ IN THE PROMPTED [FIRST ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) THE TWO TIE AT 43%, and it is the house itself changing sign: on 21/Sep it measured Flávio Bolsonaro 42% and Lula 41%. Lula rises 2 points, Flávio Bolsonaro 1, and the one who gives way is Renan Santos, from 11% to 8%, the largest fall of any name in this wave. Augusto Cury stays at 2%, Ronaldo Caiado and Romeu Zema at 1% each. 🗣️ And the SPONTANEOUS scenario of the same wave gives a different result: Lula 41% against 39%, that is, the lead appears when the respondent says the name with no list in front of him and disappears when the list is read out. ⚖️ IN THE [SECOND ROUND](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) FLÁVIO BOLSONARO HAS 48% AND LULA 45%, with the gap narrowing from 4 to 3 points against the house wave of 21/Sep, within the margin. Lula wins the other four pairings: 45% to 43% against Romeu Zema, 44% to 42% against Ronaldo Caiado, 44% to 36% against Augusto Cury and 44% to 34% against Renan Santos. 🏷️ THE MARGIN DIVERGES BETWEEN OUTLETS: UOL states 2.5pp and CNN Brasil 3.0pp for the same wave. The panel keeps 2.5pp, which is the figure from the article that reproduces the full technical sheet, and records the divergence instead of choosing in silence. Government approval in the same wave: 44% approve against 55% who disapprove, and voting rejection is 53% for Lula, 48% for Flávio Bolsonaro and 34% for Renan Santos and Romeu Zema.

PoderData in partnership with Aya, national poll released on 24/Sep, [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) registration BR-01739/2026, 3,000 voters by phone between 20 and 23/Sep, margin of 1.8pp with 95% confidence, survey funded by the institute itself (CNN Brasil, Poder360, SBT News, Jovem Pan, ND Mais and Revista Oeste). ⭐ IN THE [FIRST ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) LULA HAS 41% AND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO 39%, and both rose against the house wave of 17/Sep, which measured 37% and 36%: that is 4 points for Lula and 3 for Flávio Bolsonaro, so the distance WIDENED from 1 to 2 points. Augusto Cury gives up from 8% to 6%, Renan Santos stays at 3%, Ronaldo Caiado falls from 3% to 2% and Romeu Zema stays at 1%. Blank and void votes total 4% and undecided voters 2%. ⚖️ IN THE [SECOND ROUND](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) FLÁVIO BOLSONARO HAS 46% AND LULA 45%, and the gap narrowed from 2 to 1 point against 17/Sep because Lula rose 1 point and his opponent stood still. 🔑 AND THE HOUSE TESTS A PAIRING ALMOST NO OTHER HOUSE TESTS, with a result that contradicts the first round order: Augusto Cury beats Lula by 45% to 42%, the same score as 17/Sep, and Flávio Bolsonaro beats Augusto Cury by 41% to 39%. Voting rejection in the same wave: 49% for Lula and 47% for Flávio Bolsonaro.

Alfa Inteligência in partnership with TMC, national poll released on 24/Sep, [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) registration BR-02512/2026, 2,700 voters in face to face interviews between 18 and 23/Sep, margin of 1.8pp with 95% confidence, commissioned by Alfa Inteligência itself (Exame, Gazeta do Povo, CartaCapital, Revista Oeste, GP1 and TMC). 🆕 IT IS THE FIRST WAVE FROM THIS HOUSE IN THE PANEL, and its reliability here is 2, the lowest in the table, because it is a recent institute with no track record from a closed election. ⭐ IN THE [FIRST ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) LULA HAS 40% AND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO 33%, that is 7 points of distance, against 4 at Datafolha, 4 at Real Time, 2 at PoderData, zero at Palver and 2 the other way at Futura, across the six national polls released on this 24/Sep. And it is still a fall for Lula within the house own series: Exame records that his lead fell from 14 to 7 points against the previous Alfa wave, which is not in this panel. Augusto Cury has 6%, Ronaldo Caiado 5%, Renan Santos 3% and Romeu Zema 1%, with 6% blank and void and 5% undecided. ⚖️ IN THE [SECOND ROUND](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) THE MAIN PAIRING TIES AT 43% TO 43%, and Lula wins the other four: 46% to 39% against Romeu Zema, 43% to 42% against Ronaldo Caiado, 43% to 37% against Renan Santos and 42% to 39% against Augusto Cury. 🗺️ The house publishes regional breakdowns: Lula has 56% to 24% in the Northeast and 45% to 27% among those earning up to two minimum wages, and Flávio Bolsonaro has 37% to 34% among evangelicals, 42% to 35% in the South and 36% to 33% in the Southeast. Management: 46% approve and 50% disapprove, 55% say Lula does not deserve re-election against 43% who back a new term, and 45% see the country on the wrong track against 37% who see the right one.

Datafolha national poll released on 24/Sep at 18:41 BRT, [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) registration BR-00304/2026, 2,002 people aged 16 or over interviewed face to face between 22 and 23/Sep, margin of 2.0pp with 95% confidence (G1, Folha de S.Paulo, Estadão, Valor Econômico, CartaCapital, NSC Total and VEJA). ⭐ IN THE [FIRST ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) LULA HAS 40% AND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO 36%, and the distance WIDENED from 3 to 4 points against the house wave of 17/Sep: Lula rose 1 point and his opponent stayed at the same 36%. Augusto Cury gives up from 6% to 5%, Ronaldo Caiado stays at 4%, Renan Santos at 3% and Romeu Zema falls from 2% to 1%. ⚖️ IN THE [SECOND ROUND](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) LULA HAS 47% AND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO 45%, both one point above 17/Sep, and it is the ONLY one of the six national polls of 24/Sep that puts Lula ahead in that pairing. The 4 point distance in the first round sits at the edge of the 2.0pp margin either way, and the house declares a [statistical tie](/en/glossary#empate-tecnico) in both rounds. 🔒 THE VOTE DECISION IS LOCKED IN: 80% say they are fully decided and 20% could change, with 87% decided among Lula voters and 85% among those of Flávio Bolsonaro, ten days from the first round. Rejection of the two ties at 45% each. 🏷️ The TSE registration states fieldwork from 22 to 24/Sep and the house published fieldwork from 22 to 23/Sep; the panel keeps the fieldwork from the release and records both.

Real Time Big Data national poll released on 24/Sep, [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) registration BR-04202/2026, 2,000 voters by phone and digital recruitment between 19 and 23/Sep, margin of 2.0pp with 95% confidence (CNN Brasil, Exame, Gazeta do Povo, UOL, VEJA, CartaCapital, Sul 21 and Brasil de Fato). ⭐ IN THE [FIRST ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) LULA HAS 41% AND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO 37%, and the reading inside the house itself is one of SHRINKING: in its wave of 01/Sep, the last one in the panel, the scenario without Pablo Marçal measured Lula 38% and Flávio Bolsonaro 30%, so the lead fell from 8 to 4 points and the opponent rose 7. Augusto Cury and Renan Santos tie at 6%, Ronaldo Caiado has 2% and Romeu Zema 1%, with 3% blank and void and 3% undecided. ⚖️ IN THE [SECOND ROUND](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) FLÁVIO BOLSONARO HAS 45% AND LULA 44%, within the margin, after a 44% to 44% tie on 01/Sep. 🏷️ THE NATIONAL LABEL OF THIS REGISTRATION WAS CONFIRMED AT RELEASE, and that matters because it rested only on the sampling plan: the house writes Brazilian electorate in 16 out of 16 state polls in which the methodology settles the scope, which makes that field unable to tell them apart. Two outlets independent of each other, Gazeta do Povo and Exame, published the same registration number, the same 2,000 respondents, the same fieldwork from 19 to 23/Sep and the presidential race with no state breakdown. Voting rejection in the same wave: 50% for Lula and 49% for Flávio Bolsonaro, and 55% say they are discouraged about the presidential election.

Futura Inteligência commissioned by 100% Cidades, national poll released on 24/Sep, [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) registration BR-05268/2026, 2,000 voters by phone interview between 19 and 23/Sep, margin of 2.2pp with 95% confidence, survey funded by the institute itself (CNN Brasil, Exame, Portal VV8, Band FM and Diário 360). ⭐ IT IS THE ONLY ONE OF THE SIX NATIONAL POLLS OF 24/Sep THAT PUTS FLÁVIO BOLSONARO AHEAD IN THE [FIRST ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno), with 40.4% against 38.4%, and the switch happens inside the house itself: on 17/Sep it measured Lula 38.3% and Flávio Bolsonaro 37.7%. Lula stood practically still, 0.1 point higher, and his opponent rose 2.7. Ronaldo Caiado rises from 4.5% to 5.7% and passes Augusto Cury, who falls from 6.5% to 5.6%; Renan Santos gives up from 3.4% to 2.4% and Romeu Zema stays at 0.9%. Undecided voters are 3.2% and blank and void 2.1%. ⚖️ IN THE [SECOND ROUND](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) FLÁVIO BOLSONARO HAS 49.4% AND LULA 43.7%, and the 5.7 points of distance fall OUTSIDE the 2.2pp margin, which the house describes as a statistical advantage. Its gap widened from 4.4 to 5.7 points against 17/Sep, with Lula at exactly the same 43.7%. 📌 AN ADVANTAGE OUTSIDE THE MARGIN IN THAT PAIRING IS NOT NEW IN THIS BASE: of the 34 second round readings between the two already recorded in the panel, 11 fell outside the margin of the poll itself and 8 of them favoured Flávio Bolsonaro, including Gerp on 09 and 17/Sep, Veritá on 06/Sep and this same house on 17/Sep. The house also measures two other pairings in which Lula does not win: Ronaldo Caiado 46.5% to 42.4% and Romeu Zema 43.8% to 43.3%. Government approval in the same wave: 44.2% approve against 53.3% who disapprove.

AtlasIntel in partnership with Bloomberg, national poll released on 23/Sep, fieldwork from 17 to 22/Sep, [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) registration BR-04739/2026, 5,015 participants by online questionnaire, margin of 1.0pp with 95% confidence (CartaCapital, CNN Brasil, JOTA, Estadão and Brasil de Fato). ⭐ IN THE [FIRST ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) LULA HAS 45.8% AND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO 43.4%, and the distance between them did NOT move: both rose 1.7pp against the house's previous round, of 17/Sep, when they stood at 44.1% and 41.7%. DataTrends national poll released on Sep 16, fieldwork from Sep 12 to 14, register BR-08691/2026 at the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse), 2,000 interviews by telephone with automated answering (IVR) across the 27 federative units, margin of 2.19pp with 95% confidence, declared cost of R$ 25,000.00 (Correio Braziliense, Revista Oeste and Blog do Edmar Lyra, and the TSE register matches sample, fieldwork and cost). ⭐ THE [RUNOFF](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) PAIR AGAINST LULA CAME OUT 45% TO 44% FOR FLÁVIO BOLSONARO, a 1-point difference that fits inside one margin, so the house measures a [statistical tie](/en/glossary#empate-tecnico). ⭐ IN THE [FIRST ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) LULA HAS 39% AND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO 35%, four points that fit inside two margins of 2.19. CNT/MDA national poll released on Sep 15, fieldwork from Sep 9 to 13, register BR-06902/2026 at the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse), 2,002 face-to-face in-person interviews in households and at footfall points with voters aged 16 or over, margin of 2.2pp with 95% confidence, declared cost of R$ 222,453.00 and commissioned by the National Transport Confederation (Gazeta do Povo, Exame and CNN Brasil, and the TSE register matches sample, fieldwork, method and cost). ⭐ LULA LEADS BOTH ROUNDS, with 40.5% to 30.4% in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) and 47.3% to 40% in the [runoff](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) against Flávio Bolsonaro, and both distances, of 10.1 and 7.3 points, fall outside two margins of 2.2. ⚖️ INDEXA/BROADCAST, RELEASED ON THE SAME DAY with fieldwork from Sep 10 to 13 and the same margin, measures the first round at 38% to 34% and the runoff at 43% to 42%. Indexa/Broadcast national poll released on Sep 15, fieldwork from Sep 10 to 13, register BR-03482/2026 at the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse), 2,000 individual telephone interviews, margin of 2.2pp with 95% confidence, declared cost of R$ 164,000.00 (Gazeta do Povo and JOTA, and the TSE register matches sample, fieldwork, method and cost). ⭐ THE RUNOFF PAIR AGAINST FLÁVIO BOLSONARO CAME OUT 43% TO 42% FOR LULA, a difference of 1 point that fits inside one margin, so the house measures a [statistical tie](/en/glossary#empate-tecnico). In the house's own previous wave, released on Aug 26 with fieldwork from Aug 20 to 23, the pair had come out 46% to 41%: across the two readings the panel holds from this house, the distance fell from 5 points to 1. ⭐ IN THE [FIRST ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) LULA HAS 38% AND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO 34%, four points that fit inside two margins of 2.2, so in this house neither the first round nor the runoff separates the two with room to spare. The panel records both without choosing. In the other runoff pairs Lula wins all four: 45% to 35% against Renan Santos and 45% to 34% against Romeu Zema, both outside two margins, 43% to 39% against Ronaldo Caiado and 41% to 39% against Augusto Cury, both inside two margins. 📅 Today's release was already on the calendar published by the panel. 🏷️ Rejection and approval figures do not enter this record because the panel did not confirm them in two independent sources.

Genial/Quaest national poll released on 14/Sep, fieldwork from 10 to 13/Sep, registration BR-03607/2026 with the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse), 2,004 face-to-face household interviews with voters aged 16 or older, a margin of 2pp and 95% confidence, declared cost of R$ 314,628.00 (Gazeta do Povo and Poder360, and the TSE registry confirms sample, fieldwork, method and cost). ⭐ THE [RUNOFF](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) CAME OUT FOR FLÁVIO BOLSONARO BY 42% TO 40%, and the 2-point difference fits inside the margin, so the house measures a [statistical tie](/en/glossary#empate-tecnico). Within the house the pairing came out 42% to 41% for Lula on 02/Sep and tied at 41% to 41% on 07/Sep. ⭐ IN THE FIRST ROUND LULA HAS 36% AND FLÁVIO BOLSONARO 31%, a 5-point distance that does not fit inside two margins: the former stayed flat against the 36% of 07/Sep and the latter rose from 29% to 31%. Augusto Cury has 7%, Renan Santos 4%, Ronaldo Caiado 4% and Romeu Zema 1%, with 7% blank, null or not voting and 10% undecided. GOVERNMENT APPROVAL: 43% approve, 50% disapprove and 7% do not know, the same approval and disapproval figures as the round of 07/Sep, and on the management scale 32% positive rating, 27% regular, 38% negative and 3% no answer. 📅 Today’s release was already on the calendar published by the dashboard on 13/Sep. 🏷️ The spontaneous scenario does not enter this entry because the dashboard did not confirm it in two independent sources.

BTG/Nexus national poll released on 14/Sep, fieldwork from 11 to 13/Sep, registration BR-04076/2026 with the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse), 2,003 telephone interviews according to the house (the registry declares a sample of 2,000), a margin of 2pp and 95% confidence, declared cost of R$ 164,888.89 (Nexus website, Gazeta do Povo, Poder360, Correio Braziliense, Seu Dinheiro, Band and Exame, and the TSE registry confirms fieldwork, method and cost). ⭐ THE [RUNOFF](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) RETURNED TO LULA BY 47% TO 46%, after 46% to 45% for Flávio Bolsonaro in the house’s round of 08/Sep, and the 1-point difference fits inside the margin, so the house measures a [statistical tie](/en/glossary#empate-tecnico). GOVERNMENT APPROVAL: 47% approve and 49% disapprove, with 4% no answer, against 45% and 50% on 08/Sep, and on the management scale 37% good or great, 18% regular and 44% bad or terrible, against 36%, 18% and 46%. 🏷️ In the pairing against Romeu Zema one source reports 39% and two report 38%, and the dashboard uses the value of the two.
